preconditions.description: Grid dimensions n and m are within the specified bounds.

preconditions.expression: all(len(line) == m for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:])
preconditions.description: Each of the n lines in the grid has exactly m characters.

preconditions.expression: all(c in {'W', 'B'} for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:] for c in line)
preconditions.description: Each cell in the grid is either 'W' (white) or 'B' (black).

postconditions.description: The output is a non-negative integer representing the minimal cost.
The output is the minimal number of coins required to transform the initial all-white grid into the given favorite coloring using the allowed operations.
